description: This file contains internationalization (i18n) strings for the Select2 JavaScript library, specifically for the Lower Sorbian (dsb) language. It defines locale-specific messages used in the UI such as error messages, input validation feedback, and loading indicators.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the error message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too many characters, with the number over the limit.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too few characters, with the number needed to reach minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Indicates the maximum number of items the user can select.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Displays when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Shows a message when search is in progress.
